title: 6 Inch My Darling
overview:
Please guide the girls who came from the land of imagination into the human world.

6 Inch My Darling is a romance adventure. One day you come across a small box and find three living dolls inside, each only six inches tall. You have just 15 days to help them become human. Your early choices decide which of the three you spend your time with, while the other two stay close by as supporting characters. The way you talk with your doll shapes how she develops, and at the end of each day you receive a rating on your progress.

- Single player
- Memory backup save

想像の国からやって来た少女達を人間の世界へと導いてください。
